# Keep ADR composition and publication correct after custody moves

## Context and problem
D19427 moves source custody while ADR 0040 §2.7 keeps rendered Portal/SEO/tree inputs in Engine. An Engine package containing only pointers may change the published reader experience. That outcome must be chosen explicitly and verified before the file cut.

## Architectural reality
Engine owns `learn/agentos/decisions/0031-target-architecture-composition.md`, `learn/tree.json`, Portal readers and `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs`. Brain owns the seam-table checker; its qualified multi-repository reader is a companion. Current ADR 0031 describes a numbered-file corpus census.

## The fix
Amend ADR 0031 to consume the canonical qualified catalog and the single redirect convention defined by amended ADR 0006. Implement the Engine-side reader/publication inputs for that contract. Before choosing a pipeline mechanism, record the current FM ADR route behavior and explicitly settle the post-move outcome: full FM content sourced from Institution, or clearly presented pointers accepted through design review. Preserve Engine-only build boundaries. Update generated inputs through their owning pipeline; never hand-edit generated outputs.

## Contract Ledger
| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback / edge case | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ADR 0031 composition | D19427 §§1–2,5,7 | Qualified decision identities and explicit repository/custody declarations | Equal numbers are distinct; duplicate authority is refused | Amend 0031 | Exact shared corpus fixture with Brain checker |
| Published FM ADR routes | D19427 §7 publication condition | Explicit chosen full-content or pointer experience with canonical destination | Missing/stale source gives honest unavailable state, never unrelated content/false successful landing | Publication contract | Render actual semantic destination on built candidate and deployed site |
| Portal/tree/SEO inputs | ADR 0040 §2.7 | Engine owns build-derived reader inputs; canonical source stays Institution | No competing authoring copy or Brain runtime import in Engine-only path | Build source docs | Engine-only build and route/link regression controls |

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC1: ADR 0031 names the qualified composition and redirect contract, matching Brain's reader contract without duplicating its schema.
- [ ] AC2: A source-bound before/after route record settles the full-content-or-pointer outcome before any FM file move; peer design review confirms it is explicit.
- [ ] AC3: Built-candidate tests exercise the actual old URL, canonical destination and rendered content for all five records, including unavailable target behavior.
- [ ] AC4: Tree/navigation and SEO inputs follow the owning build pipeline; no generated mirror is hand-edited and Engine-only build requirements remain true.
- [ ] AC5: Deployment readback is retained as post-merge parent acceptance; HTTP 200/title alone cannot certify the reader journey.

## Out of scope and avoided traps
No FM source move, graph rekey or 0037 semantic amendment. Do not silently substitute pointers for full content or add an Engine dependency on the Brain runtime.
Decision Record impact: amends ADR 0031; depends-on amended ADR 0006; aligned-with ADR 0040.

unowned-rationale: planned dependency-bound delivery; a peer self-selects when the native prerequisites clear. Sophie retains coordination on the parent.
